svg.title: 12 hydrologic water ledger
svg.desc: Synthetic reservoir fluxes and cumulative water accounting. Recharge means effective water entering storage, rather than rainfall. Panel B decomposes all accounted water into cumulative release and remaining storage, bounded by initial storage plus accumulated recharge. The tiny arithmetic residual verifies this implementation's conservation, not watershed predictive accuracy.
